historical_reviews.deepseek: The proposed high-level query is read-only but has credential and exact-command coverage defects.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly retains full automation while requiring remote attribution, response framing and secret protection.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run location was found but excluded as authority; the IB sibling and next in-band power-reading case were compared only to establish route and function boundaries.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Remote sensor evidence is valid only after the LANPlus endpoint is independently bound to the intended controller and each reply is associated with its requested entity.

original_test_intent: Read DCMI inlet, CPU and baseboard sensor information through the verified out-of-band controller and validate each entity/instance response without altering thermal or system state.
original_method: Retain LANPlus and exact raw 0x2c/0x07 requests for the three source entity IDs, adding secret-safe transport, immutable target proof and schema-aware response validation.
manual_activity: The project provisions the approved BMC endpoint, credential mechanism, response schema, fitted inventory and range context; the end user owns PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Approved cipher and secret-safe credential source
Units, scaling, valid status and operating ranges
safety_requirements: Protect credentials from argv and evidence
No threshold, thermal, power or reset action
agent_execution_scope: Bind BMC endpoint to intended hardware
Issue each exact raw entity request
Validate completion, length and response identity
Decode units, scaling, status and readings
engineer_actions: Provide endpoint, access policy, schema and inventory

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The aggregate `dcmi sensors` call is supplemental only and its `-P` password argument must not be executed or archived; it does not prove the three exact raw requests.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an approved secret-safe LANPlus session to issue raw 0x2c 0x07 0xdc 0x01 <entity> 0x01 0 once for each of 0x40, 0x41 and 0x42 after independently verifying the BMC target, then decode and compare every response.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OOB route, source opcode, entity map and 10/5 timing remain; cipher and secret delivery are project-approved rather than guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run an identity-bound, secret-safe OOB session and collect separately attributable raw/decoded responses for all three DCMI entity groups under a common timestamp and load context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds remote target proof, credential controls and a semantic oracle beyond command-success acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The IB sibling and high-level aggregate listing do not prove the OOB raw path or per-entity response framing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong but reachable BMC can return plausible sensor data; argv credentials can leak through process and evidence capture; CPU entity 0x41 may contain multiple instances.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor sensor API is equivalent only with the same remote target proof and three-entity/per-instance coverage; omission of raw DCMI and LANPlus behavior must be disclosed.
expected_evidence: Immutable SUT/BMC endpoint and session identity
Approved cipher plus redacted secret-delivery evidence
Schema, decoder version and expected entity/instance inventory
Per-entity exact raw request and complete response
Completion, length, entity/instance, units, scaling, status and reading
No secret leakage or thermal/power/reset/configuration/log mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title, remote procedure, entity map and raw request consistently specify an OOB DCMI sensor-information read. The success-only criterion is incomplete rather than contradictory; the DeepSeek aggregate command and password handling are overlay defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and source route are explicit. Endpoint, secrets, schema and inventory are standard project inputs that can be supplied without an engineering ruling.

review_improvement: Makes remote sensor readings attributable, secret-safe and semantically validated per entity and instance.
independent_technical_reasoning: OOB reachability alone does not prove that evidence came from the intended physical server. Automation must bind the endpoint to immutable hardware before reading and must prevent credentials from entering process listings or logs. Each raw reply then needs framing, entity/instance and unit/status validation; otherwise a successful aggregate listing can hide wrong-target data or missing CPU sensors.
